requirement.statement: Manage department-scoped sales leads through the declared owner-only lifecycle with exact amounts and idempotent creation.
acceptance_criteria: One idempotent create persists a new owner-bound lead
Only the owner may update or transition the lead
Department peers can read while cross-department actors cannot

behaviors.rationale: Runtime bounded record query and detail enforce RBAC and department scope
Creation must bind canonical actor and department while preserving caller idempotency
behaviors.capability_gap: Generic create cannot expose the frozen owner-binding business command while direct CRUD remains closed
behaviors.transaction_requirement: one Runtime Action transaction creates exactly one actor-bound lead

behaviors.rationale: Department read scope is broader than the required owner-only write boundary
behaviors.capability_gap: Runtime role data scope cannot simultaneously express department read and owner-only write for one object
behaviors.transaction_requirement: owner check and conditional update share one Runtime Action transaction

behaviors.rationale: Owner-only transition under department read scope
behaviors.capability_gap: System transition would authorize department peers who must remain read-only
behaviors.transaction_requirement: owner check and state CAS commit together

behaviors.rationale: Owner-only transition under department read scope
behaviors.capability_gap: System transition would authorize department peers who must remain read-only
behaviors.transaction_requirement: owner check and state CAS commit together

behaviors.rationale: Owner-only terminal transition under department read scope
behaviors.capability_gap: System transition would authorize department peers who must remain read-only
behaviors.transaction_requirement: owner check and state CAS commit together

requirement.statement: Convert qualified leads atomically, requiring durable director approval at or above 100000.00 and notifying the requester of the terminal decision.
acceptance_criteria: Low-value conversion creates one customer atomically
High-value conversion creates one pending approval and reaches approved or rejected terminal effect
Replay never creates a second customer or notification

behaviors.rationale: Threshold branch, approval creation, and direct customer conversion require one governed command
behaviors.capability_gap: No system Action atomically branches between approval creation and lead/customer conversion
behaviors.transaction_requirement: lead lock, branch result, customer or approval, and audit commit or roll back together

behaviors.rationale: Approval decision must update approval and lead, conditionally create customer, and stage requester notification atomically
behaviors.capability_gap: Workflow task decision alone cannot perform the cross-object conversion transaction and project notification intent
behaviors.transaction_requirement: approval, lead, optional customer, audit, and notification intent share one Runtime Action transaction

behaviors.rationale: Director approval is a durable human task with approved and rejected branches

requirement.statement: Enforce sales department visibility, director full visibility, immutable customers, and exact Business Workspace menus.
acceptance_criteria: Department and full-scope reads match role
requirement.no_executable_behavior_reason: Authorization, customer immutability, and navigation are declarative role/data/menu policy proven through typed Runtime operations and conversion effects.

requirement.statement: On weekday mornings remind each owner once per day for leads that have remained contacted for more than seven days.
acceptance_criteria: Eligible owner receives one durable Inbox reminder
Replay and restart produce no duplicate reminder

behaviors.rationale: Bounded scan, per-lead/day dedupe records, and notification intents require project orchestration
behaviors.capability_gap: No metadata rule expresses a bounded seven-day status-age scan with once-per-lead/day transactional notification dedupe
behaviors.transaction_requirement: dedupe rows and notification intents commit atomically per scheduled Action invocation

behaviors.rationale: Scheduler targets a durable global Workflow that invokes the bounded Action
Runtime owns weekday wall-clock execution, missed windows, retry, and recovery

requirement.statement: Provide director-only funnel analytics, bounded lead-detail CSV export, and bounded server pagination.
acceptance_criteria: Funnel counts and exact sums reconcile to leads
Governed export preserves Scope, threshold routing, requester ownership, audit, and replay
Lists and Reports traverse bounded stable pages

behaviors.rationale: Governed prepare requires a project audit request record created through one authorized idempotent command
behaviors.capability_gap: The Report export substrate requires a project-owned audit request identity before prepare
behaviors.transaction_requirement: one Runtime Action transaction creates one prepare-eligible audit request

requirement.statement: Provision two departments, two sales identities, one director, reporting line, role menus, and at least six cross-state/cross-amount lead seeds.
acceptance_criteria: All identities authenticate through formal Runtime paths
Seed graph covers every state, department, and threshold side
requirement.no_executable_behavior_reason: Provisioning is declarative bootstrap and seed evidence exercised by the executable lead, workflow, report, notification, and menu cases.
